ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central to distal areas of both lobes. The left lobe exhibits a cleaner white field with dark speckling concentrated at the trailing edge. The right lobe features a large white field heavily interspersed with dark mottling and distinct linear black markings. Dark pigmentation is contiguous along the median notch and the majority of the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped notch with an observed aperture of approximately 75 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by water spray, limiting precise depth calculation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (1-3 pixels) along the entire trailing edge, with several larger irregular notches (5-10 pixels) on the right lobe's trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trajectory along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips; leading edges (partially visible) suggest a convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of yellowish-brown, textured circular anomalies (barnacles) are situated at the far tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel black linear tracks (rake marks) are visible on the white field of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both fluke tips and visible rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'spray' pattern of dark pixels migrating from the dark fluke center into the white distal regions, particularly on the inner right lobe.
